headline: Citizens' Confidence in the Manat Continues to Grow - Taleh Kazimov
summary: Dollarization in Azerbaijan fell 3.3 percentage points year on year to 25.2%, a historic minimum. Citizens' confidence in the manat and the banking sector continues to rise.
why: Dollarization, the share of deposits and transactions in foreign currency, indicates confidence in the local currency and monetary policy, which matters for currency and banking-sector risk.
